Preserve the backend invariant that only edits to schedule- or template-controlled fields mark a generated class as protected from later automation. Then map the resulting backend, SDK, and demo2 changes into an implementation plan.
project_handoffs.reason: The design session ended with explicit terminology and protection-boundary decisions but still needs a downstream implementation spec.
suggested_actions: Draft the final lifecycle contract.
Split backend, SDK, and UI responsibilities.
Identify any migrations or docs updates required.
